exploit_name: Insolvency via cross-service reentrancy in StakingBase._withdraw
description: The function violates Checks-Effects-Interactions by caching the global balance into a local variable, performing external transfers in a loop, then updating the global state at the end. Combined with lack of a global reentrancy guard, this enables cross-service reentrancy.
attack_scenario: Attacker with two service IDs unstakes Service A, receives rewards via transfer, reenters to unstake Service B during the callback, observes stale global balance. When control returns to the outer unstake, it overwrites the state with the original balance, erasing the inner deduction.
root_cause: The function violates Checks-Effects-Interactions by caching the global balance into a local variable, performing external transfers in a loop, then updating the global state at the end. Combined with lack of a global reentrancy guard, this enables cross-service reentrancy.
fix_description: Add reentrancy guards to all external state-changing functions. Update global state before external transfers.
notes: Contract's recorded balance exceeds actual physical holdings. The discrepancy accumulates with repeated attacks, leading to insolvency.
